source: ProtoQA crowdsourced questions (Boratko et al. / UMass IESL)
adaptation: 複数の自然な回答が実際に集まった質問を選び、日本語に翻訳・表記調整

translations.original: Name something that is hard to guess about a person you are just meeting.
translations.japanese: 初対面の人について当てにくいことを3つ

translations.original: What could be some of the reasons you could be called to your kid's school?
translations.japanese: 子どもの学校から呼び出される理由を3つ

translations.original: Name something that people usually do before they leave the house for work?
translations.japanese: 仕事へ出る前にすることを3つ

translations.original: Name a luxury people give up while traveling.
translations.japanese: 旅行中は諦めがちなぜいたくを3つ

translations.original: Name a sport that requires a lot of equipment.
translations.japanese: たくさんの用具が必要なスポーツを3つ

translations.original: Name something people might turn their garage into.
translations.japanese: 車庫を改装して作る部屋を3つ

translations.original: Name something that keeps children safe.
translations.japanese: 子どもの安全を守るものを3つ

translations.original: Name something that gets caught in your hair.
translations.japanese: 髪に引っかかるものを3つ

translations.original: Name a piece of equipment that you are likely to find at your office and not at home?
translations.japanese: 家より職場にありそうな機器を3つ

translations.original: Name an item of clothing that you would not lend to someone.
translations.japanese: 人に貸したくない衣類を3つ

translations.original: Name a cause you are likely to donate to.
translations.japanese: 寄付したい活動や目的を3つ

translations.original: Name something they give away free to attract customers to a store.
translations.japanese: 店が集客のため無料で配るものを3つ

translations.original: Name a popular dish made with cheese.
translations.japanese: チーズを使う人気料理を3つ

translations.original: Name a reason why someone would wear gloves.
translations.japanese: 手袋を着ける理由を3つ

translations.original: Name a sign that two people are friends.
translations.japanese: 二人が友達だと分かる様子を3つ

translations.original: Name something around the house that’s often replaced.
translations.japanese: 家の中でよく交換するものを3つ

translations.original: Name something parents tell their kids not to do
translations.japanese: 親が子どもに『してはいけない』と言うことを3つ

translations.original: Name a job where you have to be awake at night.
translations.japanese: 夜中も起きている必要がある仕事を3つ

translations.original: Name something people do with close friends that they wouldn't do with a stranger.
translations.japanese: 親友とはするけれど他人とはしないことを3つ

translations.original: Name something people might buy for a house that they would not buy for an apartment.
translations.japanese: 一戸建てなら買うけれど集合住宅では買わないものを3つ

translations.original: Instead of going to college, name something a person might do after high school.
translations.japanese: 高校卒業後、大学進学以外にすることを3つ

translations.original: Name something at the store you would find on the same aisle as cereal.
translations.japanese: 店でシリアルと同じ売り場にありそうなものを3つ

translations.original: Name something you need to make a pizza.
translations.japanese: ピザ作りに必要なものを3つ

translations.original: Name a reason why a person might prefer to own a cat over a dog.
translations.japanese: 犬より猫を飼いたい理由を3つ

translations.original: Name an animal that someone might teach to do tricks.
translations.japanese: 芸を教えられそうな動物を3つ

translations.original: Name something people do while getting checked by their dentist.
translations.japanese: 歯医者で診てもらっている間にすることを3つ

translations.original: Name a reason why someone might have to pull off to the side of the road while driving.
translations.japanese: 運転中に路肩へ停車する理由を3つ

translations.original: Besides birds, name a pet people keep in an cage.
translations.japanese: 鳥以外で、かごで飼うペットを3つ

translations.original: Name a reason why a child may not want to be friends with another child.
translations.japanese: 子ども同士が友達になりたくない理由を3つ

translations.original: Name something that would cause you to stop speaking to your best friend.
translations.japanese: 親友と口をきかなくなる原因を3つ

translations.original: Name something people buy that lasts a long time.
translations.japanese: 買ったら長く使えるものを3つ

translations.original: Name an activity that's often depicted in movies though people seldom do it in real life.
translations.japanese: 映画ではよく見るけれど現実ではめったにしないことを3つ

translations.original: Name something scary that people are no longer scared of when they get older.
translations.japanese: 大人になると怖くなくなるものを3つ

translations.original: Name something that would make someone change their return flight.
translations.japanese: 帰りの飛行機を変更する理由を3つ

translations.original: Name something a delivery person might see in someone's yard that would prevent them from delivering a package.
translations.japanese: 配達員が庭で見て配達を諦めるものを3つ

translations.original: Name something in your life that could cause you to lose weight.
translations.japanese: 体重が減るきっかけを3つ

translations.original: Name a reason why you might give a waiter a good tip.
translations.japanese: 店員へ多めにチップを渡す理由を3つ

translations.original: Name something that you might break on purpose.
translations.japanese: わざと壊すことがあるものを3つ

translations.original: Name a place where you might have a long conversation with someone who works there.
translations.japanese: そこで働く人と長話ししそうな場所を3つ

translations.original: Name a complaint people have about their parents.
translations.japanese: 親への不満を3つ

translations.original: Name something babies probably cry about.
translations.japanese: 赤ちゃんが泣く理由を3つ

translations.original: Name something parents are proud of their children for.
translations.japanese: 親が子どもを誇らしく思うことを3つ

translations.original: Name something you would need if you were lost in Antarctica.
translations.japanese: 南極で迷ったとき必要なものを3つ

translations.original: Name something annoying a person might do at fast food restaurant when there's a long line behind them.
translations.japanese: 後ろに行列がある飲食店でされると困ることを3つ

translations.original: Name something a boss might do and then tell their employees not to do.
translations.japanese: 上司はするのに部下には禁止しそうなことを3つ

translations.original: Name something you would find in someone's car which is not part of the car itself.
translations.japanese: 車の部品ではないけれど車内にあるものを3つ

translations.original: Name something you might forget at a hotel room.
translations.japanese: ホテルの部屋に忘れやすいものを3つ

translations.original: Name a reason someone might not want to stay in the hotel they booked
translations.japanese: 予約したホテルに泊まりたくなくなる理由を3つ

translations.original: Name a dish that is very messy to eat
translations.japanese: きれいに食べるのが難しい料理を3つ
